The Oak Depot is the first store the player will interact with. This is where the player will buy items such as axes, saws, pickaxes, vehicles, and machines. It is owned and ran by Bob Fridman.

Secrets

There's a small duck taped to the back of The Oak Depot sign, which can be accessed by ladder.

Two Dark Wizards vinyls are located on top of duct pipe.

Before map revamp above the cheese display there were a few rats pulling a heist.

On the light at the back corner of the store there is a small duck. The player can interact with it to make a quack sound. According to the item, it is owned by a @Nobody

By using a ladder at the back exterior wall, you can climb up to the roof. There is a small sign attracted to the main store sign proclaiming

"Caution: Board is not nailed, it actually uses FLEX SEAL (TM) not sponsored nor endorsed by FLEX SEAL LLC"


Gallery

By walking directly inside and at the counter without the cheese on it, you won't notice anything. Walking into it, however, will lead you into an unnamed secret room with various text on the walls.
